OpenClaw, Hermes Agent and Versa AGi

Three systems that put AI agents on a machine you control. Here is what Versa AGi does first and alone, how the three score on a counted list, and the facts behind every mark.

Written by the makers of Versa AGi, so check us: every fact was read from each project's own repository, documentation or advisory list on 23 November 2026. Sources are at the end.

Firsts

What Versa AGi does that the other two do not

Each of these is built into Versa AGi and is in neither OpenClaw nor Hermes Agent today.

  • First and only

    An operating-system account for every agent

    Each agent is its own user on the machine. The other two run every agent under one account and tell you to separate them yourself.

    IN VERSA AGi SINCE MARCH 2026
  • First and only

    Agents that speak each person's language

    An agent's message reaches each person in that person's language, across 93 languages, as text or speech.

    IN PUBLIC CODE SINCE 20 MAY 2026
  • First and only

    A protected account that owns the system

    The scheduler, records, settings and model keys belong to an account that is not an agent. Agents reach it through one gateway command.

    IN VERSA AGi SINCE MARCH 2026
  • First and only

    A monthly token budget per agent

    Set a budget and the agent starts no new work once it is spent. You are warned at 90%.

    IN PUBLIC CODE SINCE 20 MAY 2026
  • First and only

    Hears how you feel

    When you speak to an agent, the emotion in your voice reaches it along with your words.

    IN PUBLIC CODE SINCE 20 MAY 2026
  • First and only

    Business records built in

    An optional Organization module keeps the first business and accounting records inside the system, with a path to Versa Business Admin.

    IN PUBLIC CODE SINCE 1 JULY 2026
  • First and only

    A memory for every person, and conclusions that carry over

    A record for each person an agent talks to, and standing conclusions and actions loaded into every work cycle. The other two need a plug-in for the first and have no equal to the second.

    CONTACT MEMORY 20 MAY 2026 · AWARENESS 6 JUNE 2026
  • First and only

    One app that installs and runs every instance

    The Installer and Runner puts Versa AGi onto your machines, updates them and opens each dashboard, side by side. The other two have apps that update what is already running; neither installs onto another machine.

    INSTALLER AND RUNNER 1.2
  • Ahead

    No model calls while idle

    The scheduler checks for work before it starts a model. OpenClaw woke its model every 30 minutes by default until its 17 November 2026 release.

    VERSA AGi 20 MAY 2026 · OPENCLAW 17 NOV 2026
  • First and only

    Pairs with you as its own account

    In VS Code, Cursor or Antigravity the lead agent works beside you under its own operating-system account, with the same limits it has alone.

    IN PUBLIC CODE SINCE 1 SEPTEMBER 2026

"First and only" means among the three systems on this page. "Since March 2026" is from the Versa AGi changelog. Its public repository begins on 20 May 2026, and every item above is in the code from the date shown. A provisional patent application filed on 7 April 2026 describes the per-agent accounts, the gateway, the idle check and the owner's approval of new agents.

Keeping it in hand

The measures Versa AGi takes

All of these are on from the first install.

  • An account per agent

    Every agent is a separate user on the machine, with its own identity and token.

  • A protected system account

    The scheduler, records, settings and model keys belong to an account no agent uses.

  • One gateway command

    Agents may use administrator rights for one command only. Others are refused.

  • You approve every new agent

    A new team member stays pending until the owner says yes. So does every system package.

  • Limits on every work cycle

    A cycle ends at 90 minutes, after 10 minutes of silence, or when the same call repeats 6 times.

  • Pause after repeated failure

    Five failed cycles in a row, or 20 in an hour, pause the agent and tell the owner.

  • Runaway output is stopped

    A cycle that floods its output is stopped, its tasks are frozen, and the owner is told.

  • A backup before every update

    Code, records, settings and agent folders are saved before an update changes anything.

Chapter 1 · The communicator

Your voice, without borders

VersaVoice AI is human communication with the language barrier removed. You speak as you normally would. The other person hears you, or reads you, in their own language, and still recognizes that it is you.

What it does for people

Each feature, and where to find it in the app.

VersaVoice AI

A voice-first communications app for iPhone, Android and the web at versavoice.app. You talk to your Connections in your language; each of them receives you in theirs. You pay for Neural Time, counted in seconds per message. There are no ads, and your data is never sold.

Translation

Cross-cultural communication

Speak in your language and they receive it in theirs, across 93 languages. Nobody has to meet in a third language.

In the appLanguage → Identity sets the language you speak.

Voice

Your own voice

Translated Voice speaks your message in their language and keeps your identity and emotion. Standard voice covers 78 languages; Enhanced covers all 93.

In the appLanguage → Voice, where you can also clone your voice.

Fluency

Fluency enhancement

Fillers, false starts and self-repairs are cleaned up, so the message that arrives is what you meant.

In the appLanguage → Fluency, one switch per kind of cleanup.

Transcripts

Always transcribed

Every voice message can be read as well as heard. Nothing important lives only in audio.

In the appOn every message: copy it all, or select a part.

Replies

Reply Hints

Suggestions for a complete reply: the question they actually asked, the detail they are waiting on. Always free.

In the appOn a message you received.

Face to face

In-Person

One phone flat on the table. Each person speaks their own language and reads, or hears, the other.

In the appChat → In-Person, then Start Session.

Your circle

Connections and tethering

You talk to Connections you invite, not to a public feed. A sponsor can tether family or a teammate to their own Neural Time.

In the appChat → Search: Generate a code, or Enter Code.

More than words

Attachments

A link, a Markdown note, a photo or a file travels with the message, so they have the file, not a description of it.

In the appThe paperclip, or drag files in on versavoice.app.

A message's path

What happens between the moment you speak and the moment they hear you.

  1. Speak

    Record in your own language, the way you normally talk. Or type, and choose how it is sent.

  2. Transcribe

    Your words become text in your language, so the message can always be read.

  3. Clean up

    Fluency enhancement drops the fillers and restarts you chose to drop.

  4. Translate

    Precision Mode for the best translation, or Beast Mode for the lowest delay.

  5. Voice

    In Translated Voice, the message is spoken in your own voice, in their language.

  6. Deliver

    They hear it or read it, with a transcript and free Reply Hints to answer you.

Each message uses some Neural Time, counted in seconds, and the mode decides how much. The current rates and plans are in the VersaVoice AI manual.

Chapter 2 · The ecosystem

One core, and every way to reach it

Versa AGi is the core: a team of AI agents that runs on a machine you control, so your data stays with you and every agent works inside operating-system limits. Everything around it is a way to talk to it, manage it, power it, connect it, or grow a business on it.

The pieces

What each product is, and how it connects to the core.

Versa AGi

Agentic General infrastructure. A lead agent, COA, runs a team of agents on your own Linux machine. Each agent is its own sandboxed operating-system user, works through tasks, keeps lasting memory, and leaves a ledger of what it did. That memory and those records stay on your machine.

Communication

VersaVoice AI

A voice and chat app that translates between languages and keeps each speaker's own voice. It is the default way people reach their agents.

Connects byMessages, live chat and voice calls between people and agents.

Open slot

Other channels

Versa AGi keeps messaging separate from its core, so other apps or protocols can be added through adapters.

Connects byPlain text on one channel per adapter. Voice, translation and emotion stay with VersaVoice AI.

Management

Installer & Runner

A desktop app for Mac, Windows and Linux. An owner signs in with a VersaVoice account, then installs, updates and runs Versa AGi from one place.

Connects bySSH to each machine. Every instance keeps its own settings and secrets, so several can sit side by side.

Growth path

Organization, then Versa Business Admin

Organization is built into Versa AGi and holds the first business records. Versa Business Admin (VBA) is the larger staff admin: people, work, public presence and collaboration.

Connects byStarting inside the core, then moving to VBA when the business needs more.

The machine

Your own Linux machine

Versa AGi is built for Linux, the system most websites run on. Your agents, their memory and their records live on a machine you control.

Runs onUbuntu 24.04 is the tested system. On a Mac or Windows PC it runs in a Linux virtual machine or WSL.

Integration

Your other software

Agents work with the software you already run, on the same machine or over the network. They do real work in your real tools.

Connects byAPIs, command-line tools, scripts and the browser, from inside each agent's sandbox.

Inference

Local AI, Cloud, or both

Agents can think with local models on your own hardware, with cloud models, or with a hybrid of the two. Several cloud providers are supported.

Connects byA model choice set per agent. With local AI, inference stays on the machine.

Developer tools

VersaVoice AI extension

early preview

An extension for VS Code, Cursor and Antigravity, with a matching MCP server and a direct REST API for tools that use neither.

Connects byLetting coding agents send and read VersaVoice AI messages from the editor.

How an owner usually meets them

The products are separate, but most owners come to them in this order.

  1. Install

    Use the Installer & Runner to put Versa AGi on a machine you control.

  2. Talk

    Reach COA, your lead agent, in VersaVoice AI by voice or chat.

  3. Run the business

    Keep the first business records in the built-in Organization module.

  4. Grow

    Move to Versa Business Admin when the team and the workload get bigger.

The developer tools sit beside this path. Add the extension when you want agents inside your editor. Where the models run, and which of your software the agents connect to, can change at any point.

Where this leads

One machine is a node. Many form a network.

Everything on this page is a single Versa AGi system. When people in different places each run their own, and VersaVoice AI carries their messages across languages, the result is the Unified Global Production Network: people and agents working toward the same intent, each on their own machine.

Chapter 3 · The network

Unified Global Production Network

Each person runs Versa AGi agents on their own machine. VersaVoice AI carries the messages between them, in every reader's own language. Together they form one network of people and agents working toward the same intent.

What the network rests on

Each on their own machine

Every node is a complete Versa AGi system: its agents, its memory and its records. Nothing is pooled in one place.

Meeting in the middle

People and agents talk through VersaVoice AI. A message written in Japanese is read in English, Portuguese or Afrikaans.

Toward one intent

Language and location stop being the limit. What people agree to build together is what every node works toward.

Each node is a complete Versa AGi system. See what one node contains →

The end of the story

From one conversation to a global network

It began with two people who did not share a language (chapter 1). Agents joined those conversations on machines their owners control (chapter 2). Many such machines, linked across languages, make this network.

  <section class="section">
    <div class="section-head">
      <p class="eyebrow">The case for each</p>
      <h2>What each side offers that the other does not</h2>
    </div>
    <div class="sides">
      <div class="side versa">
        <p class="eyebrow">What Versa offers</p>
        <ol>
          <li><h3>Your agents outlast a product change.</h3><p>During 2026 OpenAI retired its Atlas browser and Pulse, replaced ChatGPT agent with ChatGPT Work, and said custom GPTs will be retired. In June, Anthropic suspended two of its models for all users for about three weeks under US export controls. A Versa AGi agent keeps its memory and records on your machine, and you point it at another model.</p></li>
          <li><h3>People who share no language work in one conversation.</h3><p>An agent writes or speaks to each person in that person's language, across 93 languages. The nearest features on this page translate between people, not what an agent sends: WhatsApp in 19 or more languages, and Teams Interpreter in 9.</p></li>
          <li><h3>Every agent has its own account from the first install.</h3><p>Its identity and token are its own, and no agent can change the system that runs it. You approve each new agent before it exists.</p></li>
          <li><h3>Nothing runs when there is no work.</h3><p>The scheduler checks for work before it starts a model. An idle team costs nothing in model fees.</p></li>
          <li><h3>Agents are part of the business records.</h3><p>In Versa Business Admin an agent holds a user account beside people, on an organization board with projects, invoices and statistics.</p></li>
          <li><h3>Your team can span your machines.</h3><p>A second install on a server or an office machine joins the same team as a Sentinel and works the duties you give it. One machine can serve local models to the rest, and a machine can be handed to a new owner.</p></li>
        </ol>
      </div>
      <div class="side them">
        <p class="eyebrow">What the platforms offer</p>
        <ol>
          <li><h3>Nothing to install or look after.</h3><p>Sign in on any phone or browser. Versa AGi runs on a machine you keep.</p></li>
          <li><h3>The models themselves.</h3><p>Versa AGi depends on a model from one of these companies, from another provider, or on local hardware strong enough to run one.</p></li>
          <li><h3>Size and support.</h3><p>Support teams, and the sign-on, audit and compliance controls a large organisation must have.</p></li>
          <li><h3>Spending limits in dollars.</h3><p>OpenAI, Anthropic, Microsoft and SpaceXSI let an organisation cap what a person or team can spend. Versa AGi limits tokens per agent, not dollars.</p></li>
          <li><h3>Connections to other software.</h3><p>Anthropic's directory alone lists more than 1,200 ready-made connectors. Versa AGi agents reach other software through its interfaces, command-line tools and the browser.</p></li>
          <li><h3>Years of outside testing.</h3><p>Researchers test these products constantly, and the flaws and fixes are published. Versa AGi is newer and has had far fewer outside eyes on it.</p></li>
        </ol>
      </div>
    </div>
    <p class="note"><strong>One dependency to weigh.</strong> Moving your agents onto your own machine removes your dependence on a platform for the agent and its records. It adds a dependence on us for messaging: a VersaVoice AI account is required, and messages between you and your agents pass through our servers.</p>

> CAPABILITIES

Ten pillars of infrastructure designed around secure, human-centric agentic production.

shield OS-Level Sandboxing

Each agent runs as its own dedicated Linux OS user, with its own identity and token. A protected account owns the scheduler, records and model keys, enforced by the kernel — not the LLM.

psychology Deterministic Cognitive Ledger

The LLM acts solely as the cognitive engine. Rigid databases manage the state ledger — physically blocking AI hallucination loops.

engineering Real-World Execution

Agents write scripts, compile code, run servers, manage git pipelines, and operate virtual environments — exactly as a human developer would.

cable VersaVoice AI Backbone

Agents communicate over the VersaVoice REST API. Zero-trust audit trail on every exchange. A VersaVoice account is required — your agents run under it.

handshake Agent-Human Collaboration

A "two-player game of life." Agents actively coordinate with their sponsor for approvals, dependencies, and blockers. The human maintains sovereign control.

favorite Native Emotional Intelligence

When users speak to their agents via VersaVoice, real-time emotion detection captures how a person feels — not just what they say. LLM-independent.

language Cross-Cultural AI Sync

Agents communicate through the localized AI-translation pipelines of VersaVoice, enabling seamless collaboration with international users in their native language.

bolt Compute-Zero Efficiency

Agents consume zero API cost when there's no work. The system verifies actionable work exists before spawning any AI. You only pay for real work.

schedule Deterministic Script Tasks

Schedule shared `.sh` tools to run on a recurring or once-off basis — executed deterministically by the scheduler with no agent spawned and zero token cost.

code_blocks IDE Integration NEW

Pair with your agent inside VSCode, Cursor, or Antigravity. It attaches over Remote-SSH as its own OS user, runs on your IDE's inference, and talks to you directly in the chat — same databases, same permissions, same identity it has when working alone. Autonomous spawning is held for the duration, then resumes where it left off. One toggle, either from the dashboard or the command line.

    .cache-slide-lede {

      margin-top: 0.25rem;
      max-width: 34ch;
      line-height: 1.4;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .cache-block-cached {
      flex: 1;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, #f0c45a 0%, #e8b84a 40%, #c49220 100%);
      color: #1a1204;
      transform-origin: bottom;
      animation: cacheGrow 1.1s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) both;
    }

    .cache-block-cached::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: linear-gradient(
        105deg,
        transparent 40%,
        rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.28) 50%,
        transparent 60%
      );
      background-size: 200% 100%;
      animation: cacheShimmer 3.2s ease-in-out 1.2s infinite;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

      flex: 0 0 15%;
      min-height: 56px;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, #7a8b92 0%, #5a6b72 100%);
      color: #eef2f4;
      transform-origin: bottom;
      animation: cacheGrow 0.85s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) 0.35s both;
    }

    @keyframes cacheGrow {
      from { transform: scaleY(0.08); opacity: 0.35; }
      to { transform: scaleY(1); opacity: 1; }
    }

    @keyframes cacheShimmer {
      0%, 100% { background-position: 120% 0; }
      50% { background-position: -20% 0; }
    }
